clips.title: The story
paras: Tucked away inside Stormwind Keep past the courtyard garden, the Royal Gallery serves as a quiet hall of remembrance. It displays magnificent statues and fine works of art honoring prominent figures from the kingdom's history and the Grand Alliance.

The Royal Gallery sits adjacent to the Royal Library, just beyond the verdant interior garden of Stormwind Keep. The hall houses statues of towering figures who shaped the realm: King Llane Wrynn, the fallen ruler of Stormwind; Grand Admiral Daelin Proudmoore of Kul Tiras; and Lady Mara Fordragon, patron of the refugees who fled to Lordaeron after the First War. It serves as both a private museum of noble heritage and a quiet retreat for courtly visitors like Lady Dena Kennedy.
